summary: Community Health Systems (CHS) completed the sale of four Arkansas hospitals and related assets to Freeman-Oak Hill Health System (Freeman Health System) for $110 million in cash, subject to post-closing working capital adjustments. The deal was disclosed via an 8-K filing referencing a March 5, 2026 Asset Purchase Agreement. The purchase price reflects estimated working capital adjustments and assumption of finance leases. No board recommendation or advisors are named in the excerpt. The transaction closed on June 1, 2026, with regulatory and closing conditions satisfied. Watch for post-closing working capital adjustments and potential use of proceeds for debt reduction.
